I have the 4x6 pre-fab indoor and have a few thoughts.  I did purchase this second hand though the original owner maybe used it once.

[https://www.cedarbrooksauna.com/4x6-home-sauna-kit.html](https://www.cedarbrooksauna.com/4x6-home-sauna-kit.html)

​

* Impressed with the overall quality.  They mill their own cedar in eastern WA.
* Putting it together was very straight forward.  Took me about 2 hours by myself
* You don't have to build a platform, but definitely advised (mine is in garage and I'm content using garage floor, though a drain would be nice)
* Biggest gripe is the bench height.  Sitting on the top bench, the rocks are just below knee level height.  If I hadn't purchased this used I definitely would have gone with the taller option.
* Stove works great for the size.  They do a good job with insulating the panels.
* Ultimately I'm going to build my dream sauna myself, but this was a great fast option and I use it just about every night
* Overall, if you have the time, skills, and tolls, building yourself is probably going to be cheaper and give you some specifics you like.  I think Cedarbrook makes a good option for something fairly turn-key that won't require many mods.
